verdict.rationale: Moosend's own docs show campaign composition through 130+ customizable templates, and its lists and segments indicate audience selection. However, nothing in the pack documents the actual step of sending a campaign or scheduling it for later; triggered automation emails are a different capability. missing for 10: explicit documentation of sending a campaign and scheduling it, explicit audience-picking at send time, hands-on or independent corroboration of the full loop.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can compose an email campaign, pick its audience, and send or schedule it — the arena's table-stakes loop

citations.quote: Browse our growing library of 130+ professionally-designed templates, pick the one that matches your goal, and add your brand’s elements to make it yours.
And let your brand stand out with fully customizable templates.
If the same subscriber appears in multiple lists or segments, you’re only billed once.
Securely host files for easy access and sharing within your campaigns.
